entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I ordered a helmet and it just arrived, but I think I need to send it back. The website was a little confusing. I'm just not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference, I guess. The color... it just doesn't look like it did online. It doesn't match my bike at all. I was so excited, but now I'm just... lost. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

I completely understand. Getting the right color is important. And no worries at all, since you received it just a couple of days ago, you're well within our 90-day return window for apparel and gear.
Ninety days? Oh, I didn't see that. I just saw all these different policies and got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me sort it out?

Of course. I'm happy to handle this for you right now. Let me pull up your account... ah, I see you're a VIP member with us. Thank you for your loyalty. For our VIPs, we can make this extra simple. We absolutely want you to be happy and confident with your gear, especially when it comes to safety.
Oh, really? That would be wonderful.

Yes. I've just processed a free return label for you; it should be in your email inbox now. You can just print it, stick it on the box, and drop it at any post office. Since the box is unopened, it's a very straightforward process. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's it? That's so much easier than I thought. Thank you, Sarah!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
